snippet.title: Project Blue Files: Classified - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! 👽: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358700/Project_Blue_Files_Classified/

X: https://x.com/ChompGames_1

Between 1952 and 1969, the United States Air Force ran a classified program to investigate reports of unexplained aerial phenomena and related incidents.

PROJECT BLUE FILES: CLASSIFIED is a first-person horror game inspired by declassified cases from the program. You step into the role of a witness, exploring isolated locations, examining evidence, and surviving encounters tied to unexplained events that were officially documented - but never fully explained…
